AdditionalAttributes.description:
The L’Oréal Paris Revitalift Filler Hyaluronic Acid Smoothing Cleanser, formulated with Hyaluronic Acid and Salicylic Acid, has been specifically developed to visibly smooth and re-plump the skin. This gentle exfoliating cleanser, with the hydrating power of Hyaluronic Acid, reveals smoother, more radiant skin.

This Hyaluronic Acid cleanser is suitable for daily use and ideal for all skin types, even sensitive skin. Formulated with Hyaluronic Acid, a renowned skincare ingredient, it's known for its exceptional hydrating and plumping properties. This gentle yet effective formula, with the addition of Salicylic Acid, also works to smooth and refine skin texture. After using Revitalift Hyaluronic Acid Cleanser, 88% agree skin feels softer¹ and 72% agree skin feels more moisturised¹. 1Consumer Test, 69 women, immediate results. HYALURONIC CLEANSER ROUTINE Step 1) Smooth & Prep: Gently massage Revitalift Filler Hyaluronic Acid Cleanser onto damp skin and rinse. Step 2) Hydrate & Plump: Apply 3-4 drops of L'Oréal Paris Revitalift Filler 1.5% Pure Hyaluronic Acid Face Serum to the face and neck. This serum, intensely hydrates for visibly reduced wrinkles and plumper skin. Step 3) Revolumise & Protect: Apply L'Oréal Paris Revitalift Filler [HA] Day Cream to lock in moisture and experience visibly reduced wrinkles.
